data.gender_notes: Sayan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sayan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sayas' which means 'bed' or 'restful'. It is also associated with the Moon god, symbolizing calmness and tranquility. The name Sayan carries the meaning “Calm, Restful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Sayan usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, restful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sayan is a sacred name in Hinduism, symbolizing peace, tranquility, and spiritual growth. It is believed to bring harmony and balance to one's life, and to bestow strength and courage in times of need.
data.etymology: Sayan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Calm, Restful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sayan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
